overview.description: The Vanguard Developed Markets ex-US Value Index ETF (VDV) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in total market equity. The fund tracks a market-cap-weighted index of developed market equities outside the United States with a tilt toward value stocks. The strategy provides large- and mid-cap international developed markets exposure excluding US companies VDV was launched on Mar 31, 2026 and is issued by Vanguard.
